description: Task-shaped operating points. Pins catalog v0.5.16. Opus 5.5 runs implement.standard (medium) and implement.accuracy-first and advisor.deep (high); GPT-6.1 Sol runs fanout.explore and ui.computer-use (medium) and review.audit (high); Haiku 5.5 runs recover.report and docs.lookup (medium); Sonnet 5.5 runs implement.quota-tight (medium); GPT-6 Luna runs fanout.dollar-tight (medium) and implement.oracle-bounded (high); grok.explore-only on grok-4.7 (medium). No op runs GPT-6 Astra. op-requirements.json (DRAFT) feeds scripts/recommend_ops.py. Adds a normal, public-input-only OpenCode DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free route: bounded-gate qualification for small public implement.oracle-bounded changes and known-source docs.lookup at high, plus an unvalidated explicitly-selected review.rule-check alternative. The legacy experimental declaration remains only for historical replay. Primary operating points are unchanged. Adds narrow review.rule-check with Haiku 5.5 medium fallback; typed destinations need separate pinned per-op acceptance evidence. Adds owner-authorized (owner-asserted, not gate-qualified) public-input DeepSeek routes for implement.quota-tight, fanout.dollar-tight and fanout.explore at high effort.
